about_the_game:
Yooca: Your Life is a growing social world built around play, friendship, and creativity. Start on the cycling track, master your sprints, and prepare to explore a world that’s expanding far beyond racing.

🚴 Race, Draft, and Outsmart Your Rivals

Compete in intense multiplayer cycling races with up to 8 players. Use timing, drafting, and strategy to claim victory and climb the leaderboards. Every race is fast, tactical, and packed with energy.

🏙️ A World Beyond the Track

Your cycling journey is just the beginning. The Yooca world is growing into a living 3D life simulation where you’ll soon be able to:

  • Hang out with friends in parks, apartments, and social hubs.

  • Play mini-games like fishing, coffee brewing, trivia challenges, and more.

  • Customize your avatar and personal space to express your style.

  • Explore a connected city filled with events, surprises, and experiences.

🌈 Built to Grow with You

As Yooca expands, new experiences, environments, and social features will be added, all designed to make Yooca: Your Life a vibrant, evolving world where you decide who to be and how to play.

Whether you’re chasing the perfect race line or relaxing with friends after a sprint, you’re already part of something bigger. Your World. Your Story. Your Life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 1060 or higher / AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 11th Gen or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 5600G or higher
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia RTX 3050 or higher / AMD Radeon 6500XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card (eg. built-in)
